_about: Robert Baillie (1602-1662), Principal of Glasgow University and Scottish commissioner to the Westminster Assembly: The Letters and Journals, 1637-1662, ed. David Laing (Bannatyne Club, Edinburgh, 1841-1842, 3 vols), the chief eyewitness record of the Assembly. Volume numbers read off each title page. Named robert-baillie so other Baillies cannot collide. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
